verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an official MCP server that lets a user's AI assistant work directly inside the workspace from natural-language prompts such as "What evidence requests are still outstanding on this audit?" It covers both reads (list audits, evidence requests, linked systems) and writes (comments, attachments, status updates), within permission limits the user sets. The in-app AI Helpbot (cmd/ctrl+K) only answers questions from support content, so natural-language operation depends on an external assistant. Missing for 10: an in-product natural-language agent, documented coverage beyond audits and evidence requests (e.g., controls, risks, policies), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
